clue.text: Nothing phony — state dismissed repeated raving in scorn

indicators.note: repeated asks for the shuffled four letters to be written out a second time
raving means wild and disordered, so the letters before it are jumbled

parts.note: nothing is zero, the letter O

indicators.note: dismissed means sent away, so the state's letters are dropped from the word phony

parts.note: NY is the abbreviation for New York State

explanation.surface: A scornful dismissal of fake news, with a state's result thrown out in a rage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Raving' jumbles O plus PHO (phony with NY 'dismissed') into POOH; 'repeated' doubles it.
explanation.definitionFit: To dismiss something contemptuously as unworthy of notice is to treat it with scorn.

clue.text: Stop migrants camping here — not one is left

indicators.note: not says that the letters for one is are removed from the place name

parts.note: migrants famously camped at the port of Calais, in northern France, hoping to cross to Britain
one is A, followed by is as written

explanation.surface: Halting migrants who camp at a place where nobody remains.
explanation.definitionFit: A place where a ship or traveller halts during a journey is a stop.

clue.text: Mania repeatedly seen in work meetings — judgment at the top is lacking

indicators.note: is lacking says the first letter of judgment is missing from the words before it

parts.note: a job is work

indicators.note: at the top picks the opening letter of judgment

parts.note: sessions are meetings

explanation.surface: Frenzy keeps showing up in office meetings because leadership lacks judgment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Repeatedly' makes the definition plural: more than one mania.
explanation.definitionFit: Fixations or compulsive preoccupations are manias, and several of them are a plural set.

clue.text: Alert Pompeo and Rudy for starters — time to get involved

indicators.note: to get involved means the word for time goes inside the two letters
for starters picks the opening letters of Pompeo and Rudy

parts.note: an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: Warn Trump's allies Mike Pompeo and Rudy Giuliani that the moment has come to act.
explanation.definitionFit: A bleeper is a device that gives a warning signal, an alert, to the person carrying it.

clue.text: Clear victor — one foolishly carping too much

indicators.note: foolishly means in a silly, muddled way, so the letters of clear victor plus one are rearranged

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: A decisive winner, yet one person keeps senselessly finding fault.
explanation.definitionFit: Being excessively ready to find fault means complaining or nitpicking more than is warranted.

clue.text: Chief at heart persistently stunned

parts.note: an agha is a chief or commander in the Ottoman Empire

indicators.note: at heart points to the central letters of the word persistently

explanation.surface: A leader who is, deep down, always dumbfounded.
explanation.definitionFit: Being horrified and struck dumb with shock is to be stunned.

clue.text: Good to see — have confidence to go off and travel widely

parts.note: lo is an old word for look or see
to bet is to be confident, as in 'I bet he wins'
to rot is to go off, like food

explanation.surface: Nice to see a bold attitude before leaving on a trip around the world.
explanation.definitionFit: To journey all over the world, visiting many countries, is to roam widely.

clue.text: Not having won, is lamenting troubles

indicators.note: Not having means the Korean currency's letter is missing from the word for is lamenting

parts.note: wails means is lamenting
W is short for won, the currency of Korea

explanation.surface: A defeated candidate is bewailing their woes.
explanation.definitionFit: To afflict or bother someone, as an illness does, is to trouble them; both verbs take the same subject.

clue.text: Words about vote offensive

indicators.note: about here means around, so the offensive's letters surround the vote's mark

parts.note: the Tet offensive was a 1968 campaign in the Vietnam War
X is the mark made on a ballot paper to vote

explanation.surface: A sharp remark about an insulting election.
explanation.definitionFit: A piece of writing, the body of a document, is made up of words.

clue.text: Stoical about fate as others indicated? No way!

indicators.note: No here says the way is to be absent from the letters built before it

parts.note: the rest means the others
ST is short for street, a way
signed means indicated, as with a gesture

explanation.surface: A leader who will not step down as his colleagues did, defiantly refusing.
explanation.walkthrough: REST SIGNED loses ST to leave the answer; the surface alludes to the US President refusing to concede in late 2020.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who accepts an unwelcome outcome without protest has calmly given in to what fate brings.

clue.text: One on hand to vote late?

parts.note: a poll is a vote
ex means former, as late does in 'the late president'

explanation.surface: Someone present to cast a ballot after the deadline.
explanation.definitionFit: The thumb is the digit found on the hand, so it is literally one on the hand; 'on hand' also suggests being available.

clue.text: Genius (it's been said) philosophically isn't tweeting? Wrong

indicators.note: Wrong means incorrect or awry, so the letters of isn't tweeting are put in another order

explanation.surface: A self-proclaimed genius who is not tweeting would be unthinkable.
explanation.walkthrough: Bertrand Russell called him the most perfect example of genius as traditionally conceived; the surface mocks Trump's 'very stable genius' and his tweeting.
explanation.definitionFit: The Austrian-born philosopher was famously described as a genius, so he is a genius in the field of philosophy.

clue.text: Not co-operating in transition but it's over, as reported, see!

indicators.note: in transition means changing, so the letters of but it's over, plus the sounded letter, are rearranged
as reported says the word see is taken as it sounds when spoken, a single letter

parts.note: see sounds like the letter C

explanation.surface: An outgoing leader refusing to help the handover even though it is finished.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface refers to the 2020 US presidential transition, which the loser obstructed.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who deliberately blocks or hinders progress is refusing to work with others.

clue.text: Turned in, not feeling great after cake and pasta

indicators.note: after places the reversed letters behind the word for cake

parts.note: a torte is a rich cake

indicators.note: Turned means turned round, so in and the word for unwell are read backwards

parts.note: ill means not feeling great

explanation.surface: Someone went to bed unwell after eating cake and pasta.
explanation.definitionFit: These small stuffed rings are a variety of Italian pasta.

clue.text: Easily best in election ultimately? Quite, it should end up in court

definitions.text: it should end up in court

indicators.note: Easily, loosely, signals that best in plus a letter are rearranged
ultimately picks the end letter of election

parts.note: all means quite or completely, as in 'all alone'

explanation.surface: An easy election win, yet the loser will take it to court.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Court' is a tennis court, not a court of law, which the election surface suggests.
explanation.definitionFit: The yellow ball used in a match is struck to land in the playing area, the court.

clue.text: Country involved in machinations

indicators.note: involved in signals letters lying within the word machinations

explanation.surface: A nation said to be mixed up in scheming and plots.
explanation.definitionFit: The People's Republic in East Asia is a nation, an example of a country.

clue.text: Violent crime spate initially ignored — detestable!

parts.note: ABH is actual bodily harm, a British criminal offence of violence

indicators.note: initially ignored means the opening letter of the word for spate is dropped

parts.note: a torrent is a spate, a sudden flood

explanation.surface: An outburst of violent crime first being overlooked is appalling.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that inspires disgust and loathing is hateful, worthy of being detested.

clue.text: Put in for rerun, sore and inept

indicators.note: a rerun is a fresh go at something, telling us to run the letters of sore and inept through again in a new order

explanation.surface: Applying for a repeat election, smarting and incompetent.
explanation.definitionFit: To place something between other things, or to interject a remark, is to insert it.

clue.text: Perhaps one adult is missing when boat enters the water

indicators.note: is missing says the adult's letter is absent from the phrase it follows

parts.note: launch time is when a boat is put into the water
A is the film-classification abbreviation for adult

explanation.surface: A grown-up goes overboard during a ship's launch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Perhaps one' is one o'clock, an example of the midday meal break.
explanation.definitionFit: One in the afternoon is a typical hour for the midday meal, so it is an example of the time.

clue.text: Great man rejected — Biden finally getting busy

indicators.note: rejected, sent back, means the letters built after it are read backwards
finally picks the end letter of Biden

parts.note: at it means busy, working away

explanation.surface: A big figure loses, while the winner at last gets to work.
explanation.definitionFit: A giant of a person, someone of great stature and achievement, is a colossus.

clue.text: Meets again when screened by mirrors

indicators.note: screened by means hidden behind, so the word for when sits inside the word for mirrors

parts.note: resembles means mirrors, looks like
as can mean when, as in 'as I arrived'

explanation.surface: A group gathers again, hidden behind looking-glasses.
explanation.definitionFit: A body that gathers together once more, such as a parliament after recess, convenes anew.

clue.text: Republican deserting miserable creature?

indicators.note: deserting means leaving, so the Republican's letter departs from the word for miserable

parts.note: morose means miserable, gloomy

explanation.surface: A Republican leaves a gloomy beast behind.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark shows the definition is by example: an elk is one creature among many.
explanation.definitionFit: The large antlered deer is an example of an animal, a creature.

clue.text: Has recourse to sneaky moves, ignoring resistance

indicators.note: ignoring means leaving out, so resistance's letter is dropped

parts.note: ruses are tricks, sneaky moves
R is the physics symbol for resistance

explanation.surface: Someone turning to underhand tactics, disregarding any opposition.
explanation.definitionFit: To employ something, falling back on it as a means, is to resort to it.

clue.text: Don't allow fraudulent vote!

indicators.note: fraudulent means rigged or falsified, so the letters of vote are rearranged

explanation.surface: A cry to reject a ballot alleged to be rigged.
explanation.definitionFit: To block or forbid a proposal, refusing permission, is to prohibit it.

clue.text: Get mad with one predicting Delaware setback

parts.note: a seer is a prophet, one who predicts

indicators.note: setback means turned back, so the state abbreviation is read in reverse

parts.note: DE is the postal abbreviation for Delaware

explanation.surface: A fortune-teller furious about a defeat in Delaware.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to become furious, as a bull is said to at the sight of a red cloth.

clue.text: Naughty or nice? Virginia on the outside's a different woman

indicators.note: on the outside means the state abbreviation wraps around the shuffled letters

parts.note: VA is the postal abbreviation for Virginia

indicators.note: naughty means misbehaving, so or nice is rearranged

explanation.surface: Santa's question about whether a woman from Virginia, who seems to have changed, has behaved.
explanation.definitionFit: The answer is a woman's name, so it stands for a woman other than Virginia, who appears in the clue.

clue.text: Grow up! Not right head of state is sounding off …

indicators.note: Not tells us right is taken out of the word for grow up

parts.note: to sprout is to grow up

indicators.note: head of picks the opening letter of state

explanation.surface: A rebuke to a petulant leader who is ranting, in the wrong.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who talks at length pompously or angrily is holding forth, sounding off.

clue.text: … here with old Pence and poor Melania, essentially not accepting what's happened

parts.note: in means here, at home
D was the abbreviation for an old British penny, plural pence

indicators.note: poor suggests something in bad shape, so the core letters are reordered
essentially points to the central part of Melania, without its outer letters

explanation.surface: Continuing the previous clue: the head of state, with his vice-president and wife, refuses to accept defeat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Essentially' gives ELANI from Melania and 'poor' shuffles it into ENIAL. 'Old Pence' is D from pre-1971 British money.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase describes refusing to admit an unpleasant truth, such as an election loss.
